mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO financial_report (receipt_no, stock_code, business_year, report_code, fs_div) VALUES (#{receiptNo}, #{stockCode}, #{businessYear}, #{reportCode}, #{fsDiv})

INSERT INTO financial_value (report_id, account_code, account_name, source_account_id, source_account_name, current_amount, previous_amount, currency, value_status) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{accountCode}, #{accountName}, #{sourceAccountId}, #{sourceAccountName}, #{currentAmount}, #{previousAmount}, #{currency}, #{valueStatus}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE account_name = VALUES(account_name), source_account_id = VALUES(source_account_id), source_account_name = VALUES(source_account_name), current_amount = VALUES(current_amount), previous_amount = VALUES(previous_amount), currency = VALUES(currency), value_status = VALUES(value_status)
mapper.update: UPDATE financial_report SET collected_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE report_id = #{reportId}
